name: Sun Cleric: Holy Giant doubles Vow of the Valkyr's auto attack damage bonus, from 10% to 20%
contract: Holy Giant 681337 reads 'Doubles the effectiveness of Vow of the Valkyr and Vow of Light.' Its effect 0 is
SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, BasePoints 99 (+100%), on class mask word A 2 / word C 0x20100000;
Vow of the Valkyr 807749 carries SpellFamilyFlags word A 3. 807749 effect 1 (BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10) is the auto
attack damage bonus that the Sun Cleric melee hook adds as Amount(807749, 1, caster) percent; without the caster
argument SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue skips the spell modifiers and the bonus stayed 10% with Holy Giant (batch 5a,
ratio 1.0021 and 0.9999 against 1.0909). The script_melee_damage_dealt metric runs the melee damage hooks on a
1000 base for each level-60 Sun Cleric against its own dummy. Control: Holy Giant without the Vow leaves the base
unchanged (ratio 1.0). Discriminating: with the Vow, learning Holy Giant raises 1100 to 1200, ratio 1.20 / 1.10 =
